interpretation.runtime_safety: Snapshot/root-bound effect commit with explicit conflict and deterministic retry eliminated all tested stale/mixed-state decision errors in this exact mechanism corpus.
interpretation.identity_split: Static schedule/control/effect policy belongs in program semantic identity; dynamic snapshot/read-set/transaction/effect/root data belongs in execution/replay identity.
interpretation.blind_execution_hash_negative: A trace identity built only from semantic hash plus input collapsed all 1400 executions to one identity despite hundreds of outcome variants.
interpretation.runtime_in_semantic_hash_negative: Adding runtime snapshot roots to program semantic identity fragmented one static program into hundreds of identities.

external_analogue: PostgreSQL Serializable requires concurrent committed executions to be consistent with some serial execution and applications must retry serialization failures; used as independent mechanism analogue, not FRANK-specific proof.
